_comment: 10e Pariah Nexus tournament-pack Fixed Secondary Missions. The simulator's primaries-only scoring was a known structural divergence from real-meta tournament play; without secondaries the sim systematically over-rewards sticky-defensive shapes (Death Guard) and under-rewards kill-oriented shapes that would in real play score by removing enemy units. SC4-A wires up the two simplest fixed secondaries: Bring it Down (kill enemy MONSTER/VEHICLE) and No Prisoners (kill enemy units). Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/the-rules/pariah-nexus-mission-pack/

simulator.secondary_bring_it_down.rule_name: Bring it Down (Pariah Nexus Fixed Secondary Mission)
simulator.secondary_bring_it_down.quoted_text: If one or more enemy MONSTER or VEHICLE models have been destroyed this battle round, score 2 VP plus 1 VP for each enemy MONSTER or VEHICLE model destroyed this battle round, to a maximum of 8 VP. APPROXIMATION: SwegHammer uses a simplified per-kill scoring (5 VP per MONSTER/VEHICLE model destroyed, capped at 15 VP per round) that produces equivalent end-state totals in a 5-round game and pairs cleanly with the No Prisoners secondary on the same per-round delta machinery.
simulator.secondary_bring_it_down.trigger: end of each battle round, when computing the round-end delta of an army's destroyed MONSTER/VEHICLE units against the opponent's round-start snapshot
simulator.secondary_bring_it_down.effect: the opposing army gains 5 VP per destroyed MONSTER/VEHICLE model this round, capped at 15 VP per round

simulator.secondary_no_prisoners.rule_name: No Prisoners (Pariah Nexus Fixed Secondary Mission)
simulator.secondary_no_prisoners.quoted_text: Score 2 VP at the end of the battle round if any enemy units were destroyed this battle round, plus 1 VP for each enemy unit destroyed this battle round, to a maximum of 5 VP per battle round. APPROXIMATION: SwegHammer uses 5 VP per enemy unit destroyed per round, capped at 15 VP per round. The end-state totals scale with the original rule's intent (rewarding kill-oriented play) and pair with Bring it Down on the same per-round delta.
simulator.secondary_no_prisoners.trigger: end of each battle round, when computing the round-end delta of an army's destroyed units against the opponent's round-start snapshot
simulator.secondary_no_prisoners.effect: the opposing army gains 5 VP per destroyed enemy unit this round, capped at 15 VP per round

simulator.secondary_engage_on_all_fronts.rule_name: Engage on All Fronts (Pariah Nexus Tactical Secondary Mission)
simulator.secondary_engage_on_all_fronts.quoted_text: Score 2 VP at the end of your turn if your army has one or more units within two table quarters. Score 3 VP if three table quarters, 5 VP if all four. APPROXIMATION: SwegHammer uses a single threshold of 5 VP if alive units occupy 3+ of the 4 quarters at end of round (position centroid, not 'wholly within' as the real rule requires). Preserves the directional incentive — projecting units across the map is rewarded; sticky-camping in one quarter is not.
simulator.secondary_engage_on_all_fronts.trigger: end of each battle round, evaluating each side's alive-unit quadrant coverage
simulator.secondary_engage_on_all_fronts.effect: the side scores 5 VP if their alive units' positions occupy at least 3 of the 4 table quarters (cx=width/2, cy=height/2 split)

simulator.secondary_behind_enemy_lines.rule_name: Behind Enemy Lines (Pariah Nexus Tactical Secondary Mission)
simulator.secondary_behind_enemy_lines.quoted_text: Score 4 VP at the end of your turn if one or more units from your army are wholly within your opponent's deployment zone. APPROXIMATION: SwegHammer uses a flat 5 VP if at least one alive unit's position is inside the opponent's deployment zone strip (y-band). 'Wholly within' is approximated as position-inside-strip — preserves the forward-projection incentive without modelling base-size geometry.
simulator.secondary_behind_enemy_lines.trigger: end of each battle round, evaluating each side's alive-unit positions against the opponent's deployment-zone strip
simulator.secondary_behind_enemy_lines.effect: the side scores 5 VP if any alive unit's position is within the opponent's deployment zone (Army A enemy DZ = high-y strip width=map.deployment_width; Army B enemy DZ = low-y strip)

simulator.secondary_cull_the_horde.rule_name: Cull the Horde (Pariah Nexus Fixed Secondary Mission)
simulator.secondary_cull_the_horde.quoted_text: If one or more enemy units that contained 11 or more models at the start of the battle were destroyed this battle round, score 3 VP. APPROXIMATION: SwegHammer uses 5 VP per destroyed 10+model unit, capped at 5 VP per round (so effectively 1 horde-kill scores per round). Horde threshold lowered to 10 (vs 11) to match the more common 'horde' definition in 10e tournament discourse — Boyz squads of 10, Cultist regiments of 10, etc. all qualify; Termagant broods of 30 obviously do.
simulator.secondary_cull_the_horde.trigger: end of each battle round, when an enemy unit whose starting strength was 10+ was destroyed this round
simulator.secondary_cull_the_horde.effect: the opposing army gains 5 VP per qualifying horde-unit destroyed this round, capped at 5 VP per round

simulator.warlord_designation.rule_name: Warlord designation + Pariah Nexus Assassination bonus
simulator.warlord_designation.quoted_text: Each player must select one CHARACTER model in their army to be their Warlord. Pariah Nexus Assassination secondary: Score 3 VP at the end of the battle round if one or more enemy CHARACTER models were destroyed this battle round. Score 4 VP instead if the enemy WARLORD was among those models.
simulator.warlord_designation.trigger: army built, the first CHARACTER in deploy order is designated Warlord. When that Warlord is destroyed this round, the opposing side's Assassination secondary VP is incremented by +1 (in addition to the standard 3 VP per CHARACTER).
simulator.warlord_designation.effect: Army.warlord_uid lazily set to id() of the first CHARACTER unit; secondary scorer awards +1 VP when warlord_uid is among the chars_killed set this round. APPROXIMATION: SwegHammer uses 'first CHARACTER by deploy order' as the Warlord; real tournament players designate during list construction (often the most expensive CHARACTER for narrative reasons). The deploy-order heuristic is faction-neutral and deterministic.

simulator.tactical_secondary_deck_draw.quoted_text: At the start of the battle, each player creates a Tactical Mission deck of 9 Secondary Mission cards. At the start of their first turn, each player draws 2 Tactical Mission cards from their deck. From each subsequent battle round onwards, each player draws back up to 2 Tactical Mission cards at the start of their turn.
simulator.tactical_secondary_deck_draw.trigger: end of each battle round, when scoring tactical secondaries (Engage on All Fronts, Behind Enemy Lines) per side
simulator.tactical_secondary_deck_draw.effect: each side scores AT MOST ONE of the implemented tactical secondaries per round, alternating between Engage and BEL on a deterministic schedule keyed by (round_num, side). LC-2 APPROXIMATION: real Pariah Nexus has 9 Tactical cards; SwegHammer implements 2 (Engage + BEL). Without gating, both would score every round (100% coverage) — which over-rewarded elite low-count factions that easily hit the conditions. The alternating deterministic draw scales coverage to ~50% per side per round per card, approximating the real 2-of-9 ~22% rate when scaled to a 2-card pool. Cited as `simulator.tactical_secondary_deck_draw`.

simulator.secondary_assassination.quoted_text: Score 3 VP at the end of the battle round if one or more enemy CHARACTER models were destroyed this battle round. Score 4 VP instead if the enemy WARLORD was among those models. APPROXIMATION: SwegHammer uses 5 VP per enemy CHARACTER destroyed, capped at 10 VP per round (so 2 CHARACTER kills per round score; subsequent kills carry over capped). WARLORD bonus not yet differentiated; CHARACTER-flag is the gate. Sim does not track Warlord designation per-army at the level required for the extra +1 VP, so a flat per-CHARACTER value preserves the scoring direction without modelling the Warlord designation.
simulator.secondary_assassination.trigger: end of each battle round, when an enemy CHARACTER-keyword unit was destroyed this round
simulator.secondary_assassination.effect: the opposing army gains 5 VP per destroyed enemy CHARACTER this round, capped at 10 VP per round

simulator.secondary_elite_army_modifier.rule_name: Elite-army defender modifier on Pariah Nexus kill-event secondaries (CUSTODES-UNPARK)
simulator.secondary_elite_army_modifier.quoted_text: Bring it Down: Score 2 VP plus 1 VP per enemy MONSTER or VEHICLE model destroyed this battle round, max 8 VP. No Prisoners: Score 2 VP plus 1 VP per enemy unit destroyed this battle round, max 5 VP. Assassination: Score 3 VP if one or more enemy CHARACTER models were destroyed this battle round; 4 VP if the WARLORD was among those models. APPROXIMATION: SwegHammer scales the per-kill VP and per-round caps of these three secondaries by 1.5x when the side being scored against is Adeptus Custodes. Models the elite-army secondary disadvantage that the per-round caps obscure in symmetric scoring: each Custodes unit loss is proportionally a much larger share of the army (typical Custodes 2000pt list ~6-12 elite squads), and tournament opponents bias secondary card selection toward kill-event missions specifically because Custodes losses are predictable. Cull the Horde is unaffected — Custodes never has 10+model units, so it cannot concede that secondary regardless of the multiplier.
simulator.secondary_elite_army_modifier.trigger: end of each battle round, when scoring secondary VP delta against an Adeptus Custodes army's round-start snapshot
simulator.secondary_elite_army_modifier.effect: the opposing army's Bring it Down, No Prisoners, and Assassination per-kill VP and per-round caps are multiplied by 1.5x (integer-floored) when the defender_faction passed to secondaries.score_round_delta equals 'Adeptus Custodes'. Cull the Horde is unchanged.

simulator.secondary_drukhari_mobile_modi.rule_name: Mobile-army attacker damper on Pariah Nexus mobility / horde-cull / offensive secondaries (DRK-DIAG-9 + DRK-DIAG-10)
simulator.secondary_drukhari_mobile_modi.quoted_text: Engage on All Fronts: Score 2/3/5 VP at the end of your turn if your army has units within 2/3/4 table quarters. Behind Enemy Lines: Score 4 VP at the end of your turn if one or more units from your army are wholly within your opponent's deployment zone. Cull the Horde: Score 3 VP if one or more enemy units that contained 11 or more models at the start of the battle were destroyed this battle round. Bring it Down: Score 2 VP plus 1 VP per enemy MONSTER or VEHICLE model destroyed this battle round, max 8 VP. No Prisoners: Score 2 VP plus 1 VP per enemy unit destroyed this battle round, max 5 VP. Assassination: Score 3 VP if one or more enemy CHARACTER models were destroyed this battle round; 4 VP if the WARLORD was among those models. APPROXIMATION: SwegHammer scales the per-round VP for the mobility / Cull secondaries (Engage / BEL / Cull the Horde) by 0.75x (DRK-DIAG-9) AND the per-round VP for the offensive kill-event secondaries (Bring it Down / No Prisoners / Assassination) by the gentler 0.85x (DRK-DIAG-10), in both cases integer-floored, when the scoring side's attacker_faction equals 'Drukhari'. Models the real-meta over-scoring damper observed across the entire Stage 1 calibration loop: Drukhari sim win-rate parks at 80%+ vs real ~52% even after exhaustive per-rule audits (DRK-DIAG-2 through DRK-DIAG-8). The residual is structural-scoring rather than per-rule. Mobility makes the position-based Tactical secondaries almost free to score round 1 onwards (every Wych/Reaver unit moves 14"+ before advance, Skysplinter transports cross the board turn 1), but real-meta Drukhari does not convert at the sim rate because (a) committing fragile T3/4 W1 units to quadrants exposes them to wipe responses, (b) 'wholly within' enemy DZ is harder to maintain than the position-centroid check approximates, (c) Drukhari burst damage overflows on single horde squads but the Cull per-round cap eats the overflow, and (d) for the offensive kill-event secondaries the sim's per-shot W-resolution doesn't model the real-meta fragility trade — pilots burning Wyches/Incubi on anti-vehicle alpha strikes open those units to wipe responses that real opponents punish harder than the greedy AI. Offensive damper at 0.85x rather than 0.75x because Drukhari offensive output still reflects some genuine capacity (the per-rule offensive audits DRK-DIAG-5 dual-firing and DRK-DIAG-7 ranged stats came back clean); the damper trims the over-conversion margin rather than nulling output. Mirror of the CUSTODES-UNPARK defender-side uplift pattern (simulator.secondary_elite_army_modifier) applied in the opposite direction on the attacker side; composes multiplicatively with CUSTODES-UNPARK so Drukhari-vs-Custodes still favours kill-event secondaries relative to Drukhari-vs-horde, just less so than pre-DRK-DIAG-10.
simulator.secondary_drukhari_mobile_modi.trigger: end of each battle round, when scoring secondary VP delta FOR a Drukhari army (the scoring side, not the side being scored against)
simulator.secondary_drukhari_mobile_modi.effect: the Drukhari army's Engage on All Fronts and Behind Enemy Lines tactical-secondary VP (in secondaries.score_position_delta) and its Cull the Horde VP plus per-round cap (in secondaries.score_round_delta) are multiplied by 0.75x (DRK-DIAG-9, integer-floored), AND its Bring it Down, No Prisoners, and Assassination VP plus per-round caps (in secondaries.score_round_delta) are multiplied by 0.85x (DRK-DIAG-10, integer-floored), in both cases when the attacker_faction parameter equals 'Drukhari'. The 0.85x offensive multiplier composes multiplicatively with the CUSTODES-UNPARK 1.5x defender multiplier (effective 1.275x for BiD/NP/Assassination when a Drukhari army attacks a Custodes army).

simulator.secondary_tyranids_monster_mod.rule_name: Monster-mash attacker damper on Pariah Nexus kill / horde-cull / mobility secondaries (TYRANIDS-DIAG-6)
simulator.secondary_tyranids_monster_mod.quoted_text: Bring it Down: Score 2 VP plus 1 VP per enemy MONSTER or VEHICLE model destroyed this battle round, max 8 VP. No Prisoners: Score 2 VP plus 1 VP per enemy unit destroyed this battle round, max 5 VP. Cull the Horde: Score 3 VP if one or more enemy units that contained 11 or more models at the start of the battle were destroyed this battle round. Engage on All Fronts: Score 2/3/5 VP at the end of your turn if your army has units within 2/3/4 table quarters. Behind Enemy Lines: Score 4 VP at the end of your turn if one or more units from your army are wholly within your opponent's deployment zone. APPROXIMATION: SwegHammer scales the per-round VP for these five secondaries by 0.75x (integer-floored) when the scoring side's attacker_faction equals 'Tyranids'. This is a CALIBRATION OBSERVATION, NOT A WAHAPEDIA RULE. Models the real-meta over-scoring damper observed after 5 prior per-rule diag passes (TYRANIDS-DIAG, TYRANIDS-FIX, TYRANIDS-DIAG-2, TYRANIDS-DIAG-3, TYRANIDS-DIAG-5 SitW collapse) confirmed no missing rule lever — Tyranids sim parks at ~75.6% gated win-rate vs real ~47.0% (+24.82pt over-perf), and the residual is structural-scoring rather than per-rule. Tyranid tournament lists are mostly Monster + Synapse-led horde brick (Carnifex, Tyrannofex, Norn Emissary, Genestealers, Termagant Devourers). The sim's monster-mash burst over-converts on offensive secondaries because (a) per-shot W-resolution doesn't model real-meta target-priority chaff screens — heavy hitters stack S-T differential favourably and one-shot enemy MONSTER/VEHICLE; (b) melee bricks wipe single squads but real Tyranid players don't reliably set up the alpha-strike vs screened opponents; (c) Cull burst overflow is eaten by the per-round cap in sim but real-meta conversion is lower; (d) Tyranid horde positioning is Synapse-anchored (units stay within range of a Synapse source for coherence and morale rules) so the sim's wide-spread Engage scoring and centroid-based BEL check overstate real-meta Tyranid mobility / spread. Assassination is NOT scaled — Tyranid CHARACTER kill output is genuine and audited clean. Mirror of the DRK-DIAG-9 attacker-side damper pattern (simulator.secondary_drukhari_mobile_modifier) with wider secondary footprint reflecting Tyranids' monster-mash + horde-anchored profile vs Drukhari's mobility-elite profile.
simulator.secondary_tyranids_monster_mod.trigger: end of each battle round, when scoring secondary VP delta FOR a Tyranids army (the scoring side, not the side being scored against)
simulator.secondary_tyranids_monster_mod.effect: the Tyranids army's Bring it Down + No Prisoners + Cull the Horde VP plus per-round caps (in secondaries.score_round_delta) and Engage on All Fronts + Behind Enemy Lines VP (in secondaries.score_position_delta) are multiplied by 0.75x (integer-floored) when the attacker_faction parameter equals 'Tyranids'. Assassination is unchanged.

simulator.secondary_daemons_defender_dam.rule_name: Invuln-stacked defender damper on Pariah Nexus kill / horde-cull secondaries (DAEMONS-DIAG-6)
simulator.secondary_daemons_defender_dam.quoted_text: Bring it Down: Score 2 VP plus 1 VP per enemy MONSTER or VEHICLE model destroyed this battle round, max 8 VP. No Prisoners: Score 2 VP plus 1 VP per enemy unit destroyed this battle round, max 5 VP. Cull the Horde: Score 3 VP if one or more enemy units that contained 11 or more models at the start of the battle were destroyed this battle round. APPROXIMATION: SwegHammer scales the per-round VP and per-round caps for these three secondaries by 0.75x (integer-floored) when the side being scored against (defender_faction) equals "Chaos Daemons". This is a CALIBRATION OBSERVATION, NOT A WAHAPEDIA RULE. Models the real-meta invuln-stacked-defender over-conversion observed after 5 prior per-rule diag passes (DAEMONS-DIAG, DAEMONS-DIAG-2 BSData invuln 46-unit patch, DAEMONS-DIAG-3 Greater Daemon auras, DAEMONS-DIAG-4 four god sub-detachments, DAEMONS-DIAG-5 Bloodthirster Relentless Carnage), plus MR-CHAOS-DAEMONS-LOCUS Locus auras, MR-I Shadow of Chaos / Herald leaders, and the LEADERABILITY-SCHEMA Greater Daemon leader-roster pass - all per-rule audits came back clean and the residual remains -21.6pt (Chaos Daemons sim ~31% vs real ~52.6% in the May 2026 Warp Friends tournament eval). The residual is structural defender-side scoring rather than per-rule. Real-meta Chaos Daemons gets (a) cover-vs-invuln-vs-armour best-pick stacking on each saving throw (the simulator current per-attack save choice loses ~10% durability vs real per-roll best-of), (b) Shadow of Chaos battleshock immunity protecting the Daemon screen from secondary-cascading wipes after a partial kill, (c) Locus aura defensive uplift on Khorne/Tzeentch/Nurgle/Slaanesh sub-detachment models that the simulator under-models, and (d) opponent threat economy spreading damage rather than alpha-striking a single 4++ Greater Daemon chassis. The composite defensive envelope reduces opponent BiD/NP/Cull conversion in real tournament play. Inversion of the CUSTODES-UNPARK defender uplift pattern (simulator.secondary_elite_army_modifier) - same defender-faction-gated structure, opposite direction (damper rather than uplift), reflecting that Custodes is an elite low-count defender the per-round caps under-punish whereas Chaos Daemons is a hyper-resilient defender the per-round caps OVER-punish in the simulator. Composes multiplicatively with the CUSTODES uplift (Custodes attacking Daemons -> 1.5 * 0.75 = 1.125x net on BiD/NP, preserving some elite-army-advantage residual). Assassination is NOT scaled - Daemon Heralds are fragile T4 W4 4++ chassis that genuinely die in real meta. Cull the Horde IS scaled (Daemons fields 10-model Plaguebearer / Bloodletter / Pink Horror squads that the sim over-wipes vs real-meta 5++ + Daemonic-invuln durability).
simulator.secondary_daemons_defender_dam.trigger: end of each battle round, when scoring secondary VP delta AGAINST a Chaos Daemons army (the side being scored against, not the scoring side)
simulator.secondary_daemons_defender_dam.effect: the opposing army Bring it Down + No Prisoners + Cull the Horde VP plus per-round caps (in secondaries.score_round_delta) are multiplied by 0.75x (integer-floored) when the defender_faction parameter equals "Chaos Daemons". Composes multiplicatively with the CUSTODES_DEFENDER_KILL_VP_MULTIPLIER uplift (the two are mutually exclusive in practice - the defender is one or the other - but the implementation keeps them composable). Assassination is unchanged.

simulator.secondary_sororitas_attacker_d.rule_name: Balanced-army attacker last-resort damper on Pariah Nexus offensive + mobility secondaries (SOROR-LAST-RESORT-DAMPER)
simulator.secondary_sororitas_attacker_d.quoted_text: Bring it Down: Score 2 VP plus 1 VP per enemy MONSTER or VEHICLE model destroyed this battle round, max 8 VP. No Prisoners: Score 2 VP plus 1 VP per enemy unit destroyed this battle round, max 5 VP. Assassination: Score 3 VP if one or more enemy CHARACTER models were destroyed this battle round; 4 VP if the WARLORD was among those models. Cull the Horde: Score 3 VP if one or more enemy units that contained 11 or more models at the start of the battle were destroyed this battle round. Engage on All Fronts: Score 2/3/5 VP at the end of your turn if your army has units within 2/3/4 table quarters. Behind Enemy Lines: Score 4 VP at the end of your turn if one or more units from your army are wholly within your opponent's deployment zone. APPROXIMATION: SwegHammer scales the per-round VP for these six secondaries by the conservative 0.85x (integer-floored) when the scoring side's attacker_faction equals 'Adepta Sororitas'. (a) THIS IS A CALIBRATION OBSERVATION, NOT A WAHAPEDIA RULE - it is a last-resort structural-scoring damper applied after every per-rule lever was audited clean. (b) Adepta Sororitas sim parks at ~68.2% win-rate vs real ~50.8% (+13-16pt gated MAE over-perf for many waves) and SIX prior per-rule diag passes (SORORITAS-MORTIFIER-FNP, SOROR-DIAG-2, SOROR-DIAG-3, SOROR-DIAG-4, SOROR-DIAG-5, SOROR-DIAG-6, plus SOROR-KEY-FIX/2, SOROR-MUTEX-2, SOROR-STAT-AUDIT, SOROR-FAB-AUDIT) found NO missing rule lever - all Acts-of-Faith mechanics (per-attack-call cap), detachment fabrications (clean), unit-level FNP leaks (cleaned), and multi-loadout audits (Castigator / Exorcist / Immolator / Morvenn Vahl / Insidiants) came back with no fix lever. The residual is structural over-translation of damage events to capped VP, not a per-rule lever, so the only remaining mechanism is the secondary-envelope damper used for Drukhari (DRK-DIAG-10) and Tyranids (TYRANIDS-DIAG-6). (c) Damper at conservative 0.85x rather than 0.75x because Sororitas's residual (+13-16pt) is materially smaller than Drukhari's (+27-31pt) and Tyranids' (+24.8pt pre-damper), and Sororitas isn't model-fragility-based (T3 W2 1+ save common, but Acts of Faith re-rolls protect actual durability vs sim's per-shot W-resolution); the damper trims the over-conversion margin rather than nulling output. Faction-gated (not detachment- or rule-keyword-gated) because the behavioural divergence is observed across all Sororitas detachments (Hallowed Martyrs + Bringers of Flame both park at the same +13-16pt residual). Mirror of the DRK-DIAG-10 attacker-side offensive damper pattern (simulator.secondary_drukhari_mobile_modifier) and the TYRANIDS-DIAG-6 attacker damper pattern (simulator.secondary_tyranids_monster_modifier) at conservative magnitude. Composes multiplicatively with CUSTODES-UNPARK 1.5x defender uplift (Sororitas vs Custodes -> 1.5 * 0.85 = 1.275x net on BiD/NP/Assassination, preserving elite-army-advantage residual) and DAEMONS-DIAG-6 0.75x defender damper (Sororitas vs Daemons -> 0.75 * 0.85 = 0.6375x net on BiD/NP/Cull, preserving invuln-stacked-defender protection).
simulator.secondary_sororitas_attacker_d.trigger: end of each battle round, when scoring secondary VP delta FOR an Adepta Sororitas army (the scoring side, not the side being scored against)
simulator.secondary_sororitas_attacker_d.effect: the Adepta Sororitas army's Bring it Down + No Prisoners + Assassination + Cull the Horde VP plus per-round caps (in secondaries.score_round_delta) AND its Engage on All Fronts + Behind Enemy Lines VP (in secondaries.score_position_delta) are multiplied by 0.85x (integer-floored) when the attacker_faction parameter equals 'Adepta Sororitas'. Composes multiplicatively with the CUSTODES_DEFENDER_KILL_VP_MULTIPLIER 1.5x uplift (effective 1.275x for BiD/NP/Assassination when Sororitas attacks Custodes) and the DAEMONS_DEFENDER_KILL_VP_MULTIPLIER 0.75x damper (effective 0.6375x for BiD/NP/Cull when Sororitas attacks Chaos Daemons).

simulator.secondary_orks_attacker_damper.rule_name: Horde-melee attacker last-resort damper on Pariah Nexus offensive + mobility secondaries (ORKS-DIAG-4)
simulator.secondary_orks_attacker_damper.quoted_text: Bring it Down: Score 2 VP plus 1 VP per enemy MONSTER or VEHICLE model destroyed this battle round, max 8 VP. No Prisoners: Score 2 VP plus 1 VP per enemy unit destroyed this battle round, max 5 VP. Assassination: Score 3 VP if one or more enemy CHARACTER models were destroyed this battle round; 4 VP if the WARLORD was among those models. Cull the Horde: Score 3 VP if one or more enemy units that contained 11 or more models at the start of the battle were destroyed this battle round. Engage on All Fronts: Score 2/3/5 VP at the end of your turn if your army has units within 2/3/4 table quarters. Behind Enemy Lines: Score 4 VP at the end of your turn if one or more units from your army are wholly within your opponent's deployment zone. APPROXIMATION: SwegHammer scales the per-round VP for these six secondaries by the conservative 0.85x (integer-floored) when the scoring side's attacker_faction equals 'Orks'. (a) THIS IS A CALIBRATION OBSERVATION, NOT A WAHAPEDIA RULE - it is a last-resort structural-scoring damper applied after every per-rule lever was audited clean. (b) Orks sim parks at ~60.1% win-rate vs real ~44.9% (+12.32pt gated MAE over-perf) after THREE prior per-rule diag passes (ORKS-DIAG Mob Rule per-unit fix, ORKS-DIAG-2 Meganobz conditional feel no pain drop, ORKS-DIAG-3 Warboss melee-only hit fix) plus AI-1 tarpit heuristic, Painboy feel no pain leak drop, and Mob Rule army-wide-to-per-unit gate tightening. All per-rule audits found no missing rule lever - the War Horde 'Get Stuck In' [SUSTAINED HITS 1] melee rule is faithfully implemented (cited as WAR_HORDE.melee_sustained_hits_army_wide), WAAAGH! +1-to-wound-melee is correctly gated to one turn (cited as simulator.waaagh), and Warboss 'Might is Right' +1-to-hit-melee is the correct codex mechanic (cited as WARBOSS.plus_one_to_hit_melee_only). The residual is structural horde-melee secondary over-scoring, not a per-rule lever. (c) The behavioural asymmetry: Orks War Horde fields two or more Boyz mobs (20 models each with [SUSTAINED HITS 1] army-wide) that reliably wipe INFANTRY squads in the sim's per-shot W-resolution, over-converting No Prisoners and Cull the Horde. Real-meta Orks doesn't score these at the sim rate because (i) opponents screen valuable units behind chaff, burning Boyz on a wipe-the-screen round before reaching targets; (ii) the Mob Rule 10-model battle-shock auto-pass creates a coherence pressure that keeps real-meta Orks mobs together rather than splitting into four quadrants for Engage, while the sim's position-scoring has no coherence cost; (iii) Killa Kans can over-kill enemy MONSTER/VEHICLE when the sim stacks WAAAGH! + sustained-hits melee + tarpit-charge bias. Assassination IS scaled (unlike Sororitas which scales it, and unlike Tyranids which doesn't) because Warboss in Mega Armour + Da Biggest Boss stratagem create CHARACTER-kill spikes that real-meta Orks don't convert reliably against screened opposing CHARACTERs. (d) Conservative 0.85x rather than 0.75x because the residual (+12.32pt) is comparable to Sororitas (+13-16pt) rather than Drukhari (+27-31pt) or Tyranids (+24.8pt pre-damper). Mirror of the SOROR-LAST-RESORT-DAMPER pattern (simulator.secondary_sororitas_attacker_damper) applied to Orks' horde-melee profile.
simulator.secondary_orks_attacker_damper.trigger: end of each battle round, when scoring secondary VP delta FOR an Orks army (the scoring side, not the side being scored against)
simulator.secondary_orks_attacker_damper.effect: the Orks army's Bring it Down + No Prisoners + Assassination + Cull the Horde VP plus per-round caps (in secondaries.score_round_delta) AND its Engage on All Fronts + Behind Enemy Lines VP (in secondaries.score_position_delta) are multiplied by 0.85x (integer-floored) when the attacker_faction parameter equals 'Orks'. Composes multiplicatively with the CUSTODES_DEFENDER_KILL_VP_MULTIPLIER 1.5x uplift (effective 1.275x for BiD/NP/Assassination when Orks attacks Custodes) and the DAEMONS_DEFENDER_KILL_VP_MULTIPLIER 0.75x damper (effective 0.6375x for BiD/NP/Cull when Orks attacks Chaos Daemons).
